T: Cornfield ballpark. Corn on the cob.
D: An Iowa farmer builds a baseball diamond in his cornfield after hearing a voice.
P: Serve the main when Ray plays catch with his dad.
S: Charred corn with lime mayo, feta and chilli

Charred corn cobs slathered in lime mayonnaise, rolled in feta and chilli, finished with coriander and a squeeze of lime. Grill 4 husked corn cobs over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with the zest of 1 lime. Brush the hot cobs all over with the mayonnaise, then roll in 80g finely crumbled feta. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp chilli powder and chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Grilled Italian sausage with capsicum and onion in a toasted roll

Grilled Italian sausages in soft rolls piled with sweet fried capsicum and onion and a stripe of spicy brown mustard. Slice 1 red and 1 green capsicum and 2 onions and fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until soft and sweet, seasoning with salt and a pinch of oregano. Grill 4 Italian sausages for 12 minutes, turning, then split lengthways. Toast 4 long rolls. Fill with sausage, pile on the peppers and onions and finish with wholegrain or spicy brown mustard.
M: Crumbed pork fillet in a soft bun with pickles and slaw

Iowa's famous oversized crumbed pork schnitzel in a soft bun with pickles, onion, mustard and mayo, served with crunchy slaw. Cut 600g pork fillet into 4 pieces and pound each to 5mm thin and wider than the bun. Dust in 60g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g crushed crackers mixed with panko. Shallow fry at 180C for 3 minutes a side until golden. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp vinegar. Serve in 4 soft buns with mustard, mayo, pickles and sliced onion and the slaw on the side.
W: Cinnamon Granny Smith apple pie with a pastry top

Cinnamon apple pie with a golden sugared crust, served warm with vanilla ice cream and a drizzle of salted caramel. Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 100g caster sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Cover with a second sheet, crimp and cut slits. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 180C for 35 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream and salted caramel sauce.
K: Fresh squeezed lemonade blended with ripe strawberries and a little mint, poured over ice on a summer evening on the farm. Simmer 150g caster sugar with 150ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain. Stir in the juice of 6 lemons and 700ml cold water. Chill for 30 minutes. Pour over ice into 4 tall glasses and garnish with sliced strawberries, lemon wheels and mint.
